name: Partial Trace Preserves and Reflects Ampleness
statement: For every nonempty finite binary class $C$, its full partial-trace expansion $T(C)$ is ample exactly when $C$ is ample.
proof: The exact shattering formula counts the shattered supports of $T(C)$. If $C$ is ample, projection ampleness converts the word count $\sum_{Z\subseteq X}2^{n-|Z|}|\pi_ZC|$ into the same sum that counts those shattered supports, so the sandwich equality makes $T(C)$ ample. Conversely, the all-zero mask section of $T(C)$ is exactly $C$, and sections of ample classes are ample.
